This repository is an Angular Conduit (RealWorld) single-page application under `src/app`, plus the `realworld` conformance pack (shared Playwright E2E, OpenAPI, API contract runners, and documentation). Local agent guidance lives in `src/app/AGENTS.md` and `realworld/AGENTS.md`. The harness INIT report is [platform/init/INIT.md](platform/init/INIT.md). The system map is in [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md).

## Component map

| Component | Path | Responsibility | Local guide |
|-----------|------|----------------|-------------|
| Angular SPA (implementation under test) | `src/app` | Routes, features (article, profile, settings), Vitest unit tests, UI aligned with Conduit selectors | [src/app/AGENTS.md](src/app/AGENTS.md) |
| RealWorld conformance pack | `realworld` | Canonical specs, shared E2E suite, Bruno/Hurl API tests, Starlight docs, assets | [realworld/AGENTS.md](realworld/AGENTS.md) |

Domain terms and REST/UI contracts: [DOMAIN.md](DOMAIN.md), [CONTRACTS.md](CONTRACTS.md).

## Commands

Run from the repository root unless a skill says otherwise. Status is **documented** (see [package.json](package.json), [playwright.config.ts](playwright.config.ts), CI workflows).

| Purpose | Command | Status |
|---------|---------|--------|
| Install / prepare | `bun run setup` | documented |
| Dev server (SPA) | `bun run start` | documented |
| Production build | `bun run build` | documented |
| Unit tests (Vitest) | `bun run test` | documented |
| E2E (excludes `@security`) | `bun run test:e2e` | documented |
| E2E security only | `bun run test:e2e:security` | documented |
| Format check | `bun run format:check` | documented |

Details and patterns (TEST_MODE, Bruno vs Hurl): [TESTING.md](TESTING.md). CI references: [.github/workflows/playwright.yml](.github/workflows/playwright.yml), [.github/workflows/lint.yml](.github/workflows/lint.yml).

## Rules

Binding rules for agents (cite evidence, harness-only edits, preserve human guidance): [RULES.md](RULES.md). Recommended patterns: [GUIDELINES.md](GUIDELINES.md).

| Skill | When to use |

| [skills/run-playwright-e2e-tests/SKILL.md](skills/run-playwright-e2e-tests/SKILL.md) | Run the shared RealWorld Playwright suite against this SPA, excluding `@security` specs. |
| [skills/run-playwright-security-e2e-tests/SKILL.md](skills/run-playwright-security-e2e-tests/SKILL.md) | Run only Playwright specs tagged `@security`. |

| [skills/run-vitest-unit-tests/SKILL.md](skills/run-vitest-unit-tests/SKILL.md) | Run colocated Angular service unit tests under `src/app`. |

## Hooks

Active **pre-commit** runs `npx lint-staged` (see [HOOKS.md](HOOKS.md)). Proposed hooks (pre-push tests/format, agent format check) are listed there with triggers and failure behavior.
